method_note: Coordinates are the printed WGS84 / UTM zone 32N stack coordinates in Tables 4.9 and 4.11 of Annex A to Enel's environmental impact study for VIA procedure 5668 (document C0014931, published on the Ministry's Valutazioni e Autorizzazioni Ambientali portal), transformed from EPSG:32632 to EPSG:4326 with pyproj 3.7.1 and rounded to 7 decimals.

candidates.decision: Selected the printed position of the by-pass stack of Enel's proposed TO3 gas unit, which Enel's study places inside the perimeter of the former Galileo Ferraris combined-cycle plant at Leri Cavour (Trino), as the campus locator for the Cavour Hyperscale Campus that Regione Piemonte says will transform the area of that former plant, replacing the Wikipedia plant coordinates.
candidates.layer: Enel S.p.A., 'Centrale Termoelettrica Leri Cavour di Trino - Installazione di una nuova unita a gas', SIA Allegato A (C0014931), Tabella 4.9 (page 108/127) and Tabella 4.11 (page 109/127); WGS84 / UTM 32N

facts.study_statements: SIA section 1.4: the project site is inside the perimeter of the former combined-cycle plant at Leri Cavour; the new unit would occupy about 11 ha against the 23 ha of the former plant. Annex A section 4.2.1.4: the new unit would be built in the north-west part of the old plant area, partly occupying the decommissioned Galileo Ferraris combined-cycle plant (2 x 345 MWe, in service 1996-1997).
facts.procedure_outcome: VIA procedure 5668 is shown as concluded on the portal, with a negative VIA decree DM_2022-0000008 of 12 January 2022; the stack is used only as a published position inside the former plant perimeter, not as evidence of a gas unit

candidates.exclusions: The Wikipedia coordinates behind the previous point were not used. The air-quality receptor and monitoring-station coordinates in the same annex were not used. No map viewer, geocoder or map link was used.
